questions.text: "मानव भूगोल मानव समाजों और धरातल के बीच संबंधों का संश्लेषित अध्ययन है।" मानव भूगोल की यह परिभाषा किसके द्वारा दी गई है?
questions.text_english: "Human geography is the synthetic study of relationship between human societies and earth's surface." This definition of human geography is given by
questions.solution: The correct answer is (A) Vidal-de-la-Blache. He is widely recognized for this definition which emphasizes the synthetic nature of the relationship between human societies and the environment. Other options are incorrect as their contributions to human geography focus on different aspects like political geography (Ratzel) or the nature of geography as a discipline (Hartshorne).
questions.chapter: Nature and Scope of Human Geography

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा एक विषय के रूप में 'भूगोल' का मुख्य सरोकार है?
(A) जनसंख्या वितरण और उसको प्रभावित करने वाले कारकों को समझना।
(B) संसाधन वितरण और उनके उपयोग के बीच संबंध को समझना।
(C) पृथ्वी को मानव के आवास और इसकी वहनीयता को समझना।
(D) पृथ्वी को प्राकृतिक संसाधनों का घर और उनके आंकलन को समझना।
questions.text_english:
Which one of the following is the core concern of geography as a discipline?
(A) To understand population distribution and the factors affecting the same.
(B) To understand the relationship between resource distribution and its utilisation.
(C) To understand the earth as the home of human beings and its sustainability.
(D) To understand the earth as the home of natural resources and their estimation.

options.A: जनसंख्या वितरण और उसको प्रभावित करने वाले कारकों को समझना।
options.B: संसाधन वितरण और उनके उपयोग के बीच संबंध को समझना।
options.C: पृथ्वी को मानव के आवास और इसकी वहनीयता को समझना।
options.D: पृथ्वी को प्राकृतिक संसाधनों का घर और उनके आंकलन को समझना।

options_english.A: To understand population distribution and the factors affecting the same.
options_english.B: To understand the relationship between resource distribution and its utilisation.
options_english.C: To understand the earth as the home of human beings and its sustainability.
options_english.D: To understand the earth as the home of natural resources and their estimation.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (C). Geography as a discipline fundamentally concerns itself with the study of the Earth as the home of human beings and understanding its sustainability to support life, which encompasses physical and human aspects. Other options are subsets of geographic study but do not capture the core essence of the subject in its entirety.

questions.text:
'नवनिश्चयवाद' की संकल्पना _______ के द्वारा प्रस्तुत की गई थी।
(A) एहरलिच
(B) सी. सेंपल
(C) ग्रिफिथ टेलर
(D) हम्बोल्ट
questions.text_english:
The concept of 'Neodeterminism' was introduced by ______.
(A) Ehrlich
(B) C. Semple
(C) Griffith Taylor
(D) Humboldt
questions.solution: The concept of 'Neodeterminism', also known as 'Stop and Go Determinism', was introduced by the geographer Griffith Taylor. He proposed that human activities are constrained by nature but not strictly determined by it, and through technology, humans can modify their environment within limits.

questions.text:
पत्तनों के विषय में निम्नलिखित कथनों को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए और सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए:
(i) पत्तन माल को लादने, उतारने और भंडारण की सुविधाएँ प्रदान करते हैं।
(ii) पत्तनों के महत्त्व का आंकलन उनके पृष्ठ प्रदेश के आकार से किया जाता है।
(iii) किसी पत्तन द्वारा संभाले जाने वाले माल की मात्रा उसके पृष्ठ प्रदेश के विकास के स्तर को दर्शाती है।
(iv) पत्तन विश्व व्यापार के मुख्य प्रवेशद्वार हैं।
विकल्प:
(A) केवल (i), (ii) और (iii) सही हैं।
(B) केवल (i), (iii) और (iv) सही हैं।
(C) केवल (i), (ii) और (iv) सही हैं।
(D) केवल (ii), (iii) और (iv) सही हैं।
questions.text_english:
Read the following statements about ports carefully and choose the correct option:
(i) The ports provide the facilities of loading, unloading and storage of cargo.
(ii) The importance of ports is judged by the size of its hinterland.
(iii) The quantity of cargo handled by a port indicates the level of development of its hinterland.
(iv) Ports are the chief gateways of the world trade.
Options:
(A) only (i), (ii) and (iii) are correct.
(B) only (i), (iii) and (iv) are correct.
(C) only (i), (ii) and (iv) are correct.
(D) only (ii), (iii) and (iv) are correct.
questions.solution: The correct answer is (C). Statements (i), (ii), and (iv) are correct. Statement (iii) is conceptually flawed in this context because the quantity of cargo handled indicates the volume of trade activity rather than directly measuring the 'level of development' of the hinterland, which is a broader socioeconomic index. Therefore, options containing (iii) are incorrect.

questions.text:
नीचे दो कथन दिए गए हैं। ये अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) हैं। दोनों कथनों को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए और सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए:
अभिकथन (A): 'विश्व व्यापार संगठन (WTO)' अमीर देशों को और अधिक अमीर बनाकर अमीर और गरीब के बीच खाई को चौड़ा कर रहा है।
कारण (R): 'विश्व व्यापार संगठन (WTO)' में प्रभावशाली राष्ट्र अपने स्वयं के वाणिज्यिक हितों पर ध्यान केंद्रित करते हैं।
विकल्प:
(A) दोनों (A) तथा (R) सही हैं और (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या है।
(B) दोनों (A) तथा (R) सही हैं, लेकिन (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं है।
(C) (A) सही है, लेकिन (R) गलत है।
(D) (A) गलत है, लेकिन (R) सही है।
questions.text_english:
Two statements are given below. They are Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Read both the statements carefully and choose the correct option:
Assertion (A): 'World Trade Organisation (WTO) is widening the gulf between rich and poor by making rich countries richer.'
Reason (R): 'The influential nations in the WTO focus on their own commercial interests.'
Options:
(A) Both (A) and (R) are correct and (R) is the correct explanation of (A).
(B) Both (A) and (R) are correct, but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A).
(C) (A) is correct, but (R) is incorrect.
(D) (A) is incorrect but (R) is correct.

options.A: दोनों (A) तथा (R) सही हैं और (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या है।
options.B: दोनों (A) तथा (R) सही हैं, लेकिन (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं है।

options_english.A: Both (A) and (R) are correct and (R) is the correct explanation of (A).
options_english.B: Both (A) and (R) are correct, but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A).

questions.solution: The correct answer is (A). Both the assertion and the reason are correct. Critics argue that WTO policies often favor developed nations, and this is reinforced by the fact that influential nations within the organization prioritize their own commercial and economic interests, which explains why the gap between rich and poor nations persists or widens.

questions.text:
रिक्त स्थान की पूर्ति के लिए सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए।
व्यापार के लिए अर्थव्यवस्थाओं को खोलने का कार्य _______ के रूप में जाना जाता है।
(A) संतुलित व्यापार
(B) एकतरफा व्यापार
(C) मुक्त व्यापार
(D) द्विपक्षीय व्यापार
questions.text_english:
Choose the correct option to fill the blank.
The act of opening up economies for trading is known as ______.
(A) Balanced trade
(B) Unilateral trade
(C) Free trade
(D) Bilateral trade
questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) Free trade. Free trade refers to the economic policy of opening up international borders and economies to the flow of goods and services with minimal government intervention, tariffs, or trade barriers.

questions.text:
भारत के निम्नलिखित नगरों को उनके ऐतिहासिक विकास के अनुसार प्राचीनतम से नवीनतम के क्रम में व्यवस्थित कीजिए और सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए:
(i) जयपुर
(ii) चंडीगढ़
(iii) मदुरै
(iv) जमशेदपुर
विकल्प:
(A) (iii), (i), (ii), (iv)
(B) (iii), (i), (iv), (ii)
(C) (i), (iii), (iv), (ii)
(D) (i), (iii), (ii), (iv)
questions.text_english:
Arrange the following towns of India from the oldest to the newest order based on their historical evolution and choose the correct option:
(i) Jaipur
(ii) Chandigarh
(iii) Madurai
(iv) Jamshedpur
Options:
(A) (iii), (i), (ii), (iv)
(B) (iii), (i), (iv), (ii)
(C) (i), (iii), (iv), (ii)
(D) (i), (iii), (ii), (iv)
questions.solution: The correct order from oldest to newest is: (iii) Madurai (Ancient), (i) Jaipur (Medieval/Pre-colonial), (iv) Jamshedpur (Modern/Industrial era, early 20th century), and (ii) Chandigarh (Post-independence modern planned city). Thus, the correct sequence is (iii), (i), (iv), (ii), which corresponds to option (B).

questions.text:
स्मार्ट सिटी मिशन के उद्देश्यों से संबंधित निम्नलिखित कथनों को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए और सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए:
(i) साफ और सतत पर्यावरण के साथ शहर को बढ़ावा देना।
(ii) अपने नागरिकों को गुणवत्तापूर्ण बेहतर जीवन प्रदान करना।
(iii) नौकरी तलाश करने वालों को रोजगार प्रदान करना।
(iv) शहर को आपदाओं के प्रति जोखिम कम करने वाला बनाना।
विकल्प:
(A) केवल (ii), (iii) और (iv) सही हैं।
(B) केवल (i), (iii) और (iv) सही हैं।
(C) केवल (i), (ii) और (iii) सही हैं।
(D) केवल (i), (ii) और (iv) सही हैं।
questions.text_english:
Read the following statements related to the objectives of smart city mission carefully and choose the correct option:
(i) To promote the city with clean and sustainable environment.
(ii) To provide decent quality of life to its citizens.
(iii) To provide employment to the job seekers.
(iv) To make the city less vulnerable to disasters.
Options:
(A) Only (ii), (iii) and (iv) are correct.
(B) Only (i), (iii) and (iv) are correct.
(C) Only (i), (ii) and (iii) are correct.
(D) Only (i), (ii) and (iv) are correct.
questions.solution: The correct answer is (D). The primary objectives of the Smart City Mission involve providing quality life (ii), creating a sustainable and clean environment (i), and disaster resilience (iv). Providing direct employment to job seekers (iii) is not a direct, primary objective defined under the mission's scope; rather, the mission focuses on creating an environment conducive to economic growth and development.

questions.text:
भारत में पन्ना, पाड़ा, पाली, नगला, ढाँणी आदि स्थानीय नाम निम्नलिखित में से किस प्रकार की ग्रामीण बस्तियों के उदाहरण हैं?
(A) गुच्छित बस्ती
(B) अर्द्ध-गुच्छित बस्ती
(C) पल्ली बस्ती
(D) परिक्षिप्त बस्ती
questions.text_english:
Local names like Panna, Para, Palli, Nagla, Dhani etc. are examples of which of the following types of rural settlements in India?
(A) Clustered settlement
(B) Semi-clustered settlement
(C) Hamleted settlement
(D) Dispersed settlement
questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) Hamleted settlement. These local terms in various Indian regions refer to fragmented or smaller clusters of dwellings that collectively form a larger village, characteristic of a hamleted settlement pattern.

questions.text:
नीचे दो कथन दिए गए हैं। ये अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) हैं। दोनों कथनों को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए और सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए:
अभिकथन (A): कृषि में समृद्ध राज्य पंजाब, हरियाणा और पश्चिमी उत्तर प्रदेश भूजल की कमी के संकट का सामना कर रहे हैं।
कारण (R): जल स्तर पुनर्भरण की तुलना में सिंचाई के लिए अधिक भूजल का उपयोग किया जाता है।
विकल्प:
(A) दोनों (A) तथा (R) सही हैं और (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या है।
(B) दोनों (A) तथा (R) सही हैं, लेकिन (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं हैं।
(C) (A) सही नहीं है, लेकिन (R) सही है।
(D) (A) सही है, लेकिन (R) सही नहीं है।
questions.text_english:
Two statements are given below. They are Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Read both the statements carefully and choose the correct option:
Assertion (A): 'The agriculturally rich states of Punjab, Haryana and western Uttar Pradesh are facing the crisis of groundwater depletion.'
Reason (R): 'More groundwater is utilised for irrigation than water-table recharge.'
Options:
(A) Both (A) and (R) are correct and (R) is correct reason of (A).
(B) Both (A) and (R) are correct, but (R) is not the correct reason of (A).
(C) (A) is not correct, but (R) is correct.
(D) (A) is correct, but (R) is not correct.

options.A: दोनों (A) तथा (R) सही हैं और (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या है।
options.B: दोनों (A) तथा (R) सही हैं, लेकिन (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं हैं।
options.C: (A) सही नहीं है, लेकिन (R) सही है।
options.D: (A) सही है, लेकिन (R) सही नहीं है।

options_english.A: Both (A) and (R) are correct and (R) is correct reason of (A).
options_english.B: Both (A) and (R) are correct, but (R) is not the correct reason of (A).
options_english.C: (A) is not correct, but (R) is correct.
options_english.D: (A) is correct, but (R) is not correct.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (A). The excessive use of groundwater for intensive agricultural practices in these states, which exceeds the natural rate of replenishment through recharging processes, is the direct cause of the significant depletion of the water table in these regions.

questions.text:
इंदिरा गांधी नहर परियोजना से संबंधित निम्नलिखित कथनों को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए और सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए:
(i) इंदिरा गांधी नहर परियोजना को 1950 में कँवर सेन द्वारा संकल्पित किया गया था और इसको 1961 में प्रारंभ किया गया था।
(ii) नहर सिंचाई की शुरुआत से कमांड क्षेत्र की कृषि अर्थव्यवस्था में उल्लेखनीय परिवर्तन आया है।
(iii) नहर सिंचाई के प्रसार से खेती के क्षेत्र और फसल सघनता में वृद्धि हुई है।
(iv) ज्वार-बाजरे की परंपरागत फसलों को गेहूँ और चावल आदि ने प्रतिस्थापित कर दिया है।
विकल्प:
(A) केवल (i), (ii) और (iv) सही हैं।
(B) केवल (i), (ii) और (iii) सही हैं।
(C) केवल (i), (iii) और (iv) सही हैं।
(D) केवल (ii), (iii) और (iv) सही हैं।
questions.text_english:
Read the following statements related to Indira Gandhi Canal Project carefully and choose the correct option:
(i) Indira Gandhi Canal project was conceived by Kanwar Sain in 1950 and it was launched in 1961.
(ii) Introduction of canal irrigation has brought perceptible changes in the agricultural economy of the command area.
(iii) Spread of canal irrigation has led to increase in cultivated area and crop intensity.
(iv) Traditional crops of jowar, bajra has been replaced by rice and wheat etc.
Options:
(A) (i), (ii) and (iv) only are correct.
(B) (i), (ii) and (iii) only are correct.
(C) (i), (iii) and (iv) only are correct.
(D) (ii), (iii) and (iv) only are correct.
questions.solution: The correct answer is (D). While statements (ii), (iii), and (iv) accurately describe the impacts of the Indira Gandhi Canal, statement (i) is factually incorrect regarding the launch date in this context. The project was conceived in 1948 by Kanwar Sain, and work began much earlier than 1961, which makes option (D) the only set excluding the factually incorrect statement.

questions.text:
भारत के अंतर्राष्ट्रीय व्यापार से संबंधित निम्नलिखित कथनों को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए और सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए:
(i) भारत की एक लंबी तटरेखा है जो तीन तरफ से समुद्र से घिरी हुई है।
(ii) भारत के तट पर बड़ी संख्या में सुविकसित पत्तन हैं।
(iii) कांडला पत्तन बड़ी मात्रा में लौह अयस्क का निर्यात करता है।
(iv) भारी-भरकम वस्तुओं का जलमार्ग द्वारा परिवहन खर्च बहुत सस्ता है।
विकल्प:
(A) केवल (i), (ii) और (iv) सही हैं।
(B) केवल (i), (ii) और (iii) सही हैं।
(C) केवल (i), (iii) और (iv) सही हैं।
(D) केवल (ii), (iii) और (iv) सही हैं।
questions.text_english:
Read the following statements related to international trade of India carefully and choose the correct option:
(i) India has a long coastline surrounded by ocean from three sides.
(ii) Indian coasts have large number of well-developed sea ports.
(iii) Kandla port exports huge amount of iron-ore.
(iv) The transportation cost by water is very cheap for voluminous items.
Options:
(A) Only (i), (ii) and (iv) are correct.
(B) Only (i), (ii) and (iii) are correct.
(C) Only (i), (iii) and (iv) are correct.
(D) Only (ii), (iii) and (iv) are correct.
questions.solution: The correct answer is (A). Statements (i), (ii), and (iv) are accurate descriptions of India's maritime geography and trade logistics. Statement (iii) is incorrect because Kandla (now Deendayal Port) is primarily known as a major hub for petroleum and other cargo rather than being the primary exporter of iron ore, which is handled largely by ports like Mormugao or Visakhapatnam.

questions.text:
ऐसा क्यों है कि झुग्गी बस्तियाँ (slums) सबसे कम विकल्प वाला निवास क्षेत्र है? सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए:
(i) इनमें खराब वेंटिलेशन वाले जर्जर घर हैं।
(ii) रोशनी और शौचालय जैसी बुनियादी सुविधाएँ मिलना मुश्किल हैं।
(iii) स्वास्थ्यकर परिस्थितियाँ और पेयजल अव्यवस्थित हैं।
(iv) बेहतर जल-निकासी सुविधाएँ उपलब्ध हैं।
विकल्प:
(A) केवल (i), (ii) और (iii) सही हैं।
(B) केवल (ii), (iii) और (iv) सही हैं।
(C) केवल (i), (iii) और (iv) सही हैं।
(D) केवल (i), (ii) और (iv) सही हैं।
questions.text_english:
Why is it that slums are the areas of residence with least choice? Choose the correct options:
(i) They have dilapidated houses with poor ventilation.
(ii) The basic facilities like lights and toilets are difficult to get.
(iii) Hygienic conditions and drinking water are improper.
(iv) Better drainage facilities are available.
Options:
(A) Only (i), (ii) and (iii) are correct.
(B) Only (ii), (iii) and (iv) are correct.
(C) Only (i), (iii) and (iv) are correct.
(D) Only (i), (ii) and (iv) are correct.
questions.solution: The correct answer is (A). Slums are characterized by dilapidated housing, poor ventilation, lack of basic amenities, and unsanitary conditions, making them undesirable places to live, which is why they represent the least choice. Statement (iv) is incorrect because drainage facilities in slums are typically severely lacking, not 'better'.

questions.text_english:
(a) Examine the role of climate, water availability and soil fertility on the distribution of world population.
OR
(b) Examine three stages of demographic transition theory.

key_points: Climate: People prefer moderate climates; extreme hot/cold areas are sparsely populated.
Water availability: Major civilizations developed near rivers; water is essential for daily life and agriculture.
Soil fertility: Fertile soil supports agriculture, attracting large populations in river valleys.

questions.solution: Climate, water, and soil are vital determinants of population distribution. People generally prefer moderate climates, as harsh environments like extreme heat or cold are difficult to inhabit. Water is essential for survival and economic activity, which is why historical civilizations thrived in river valleys. Fertile soil, found in these plains, supports intensive agriculture, providing food security for large populations. Together, these three factors dictate that regions with favorable combinations of these conditions are densely populated, while those lacking them remain sparse.

questions.text_english: Explain the main characteristics of rural roads in India.

key_points: Connect rural villages to towns and cities.
Often seasonal and lack all-weather connectivity.

questions.solution: Rural roads in India are crucial for connecting remote villages to larger towns and market centers. Their main characteristic is that they facilitate the transport of agricultural produce to markets and the movement of essential goods into rural areas. However, many of these roads are still seasonal and lack all-weather connectivity, which hinders accessibility during the monsoon season. Despite government initiatives to expand and improve them, they remain a foundational part of the rural transport network.

questions.text: 'नमामि गंगे कार्यक्रम' के उद्देश्यों को प्राप्त करने के लिए उपाय सुझाइए।
questions.question_english: Suggest the measures to achieve the objectives of 'Namami Gange Programme'.

key_points: Reduction of sewage disposal into the river.

questions.solution: To achieve the objectives of the Namami Gange Programme, several measures are essential. Strict regulations must be enforced to ensure industrial effluents are treated before being discharged. A comprehensive infrastructure plan is needed to prevent untreated sewage from urban areas from entering the river. Furthermore, fostering community awareness and encouraging active public participation in river-front development and cleanliness drives are vital to ensuring the long-term success of the river rejuvenation initiative.

questions.text: 'मानव विकास' की अवधारणा को स्पष्ट कीजिए। मानव विकास के चार उपागमों का मूल्यांकन कीजिए।
questions.text_english: Explain the concept of 'human development'. Examine four approaches to human development.

key_points: Concept: Human development focuses on widening choices and enhancing human capabilities.
Approaches: Income approach (link between income and development).
Basic needs approach (six basic needs identified by ILO).

questions.solution: Human development is defined as the process of widening people’s choices and raising their level of well-being, focusing on enhancing human capabilities to lead long, healthy, and creative lives. The four main approaches include: First, the Income approach, which sees income as a proxy for development; the higher the income, the higher the level of human development. Second, the Welfare approach, which treats human beings as beneficiaries of government-funded development activities in education, health, and housing. Third, the Basic Needs approach, proposed by the ILO, which identifies six basic needs: health, education, food, water supply, sanitation, and housing. Finally, the Capability approach, associated with Prof. Amartya Sen, which emphasizes the development of human capabilities as the core of human development.

questions.text_english:
(a) Explain the main features of large scale manufacturing industries in the world.
OR
(b) Explain the main features of 'High Tech' industries in the world.

key_points: Large scale features: Specialized workers, mass production, high capital investment, complex organization, and extensive technology.
High Tech features: R&D focus, highly skilled workforce, quick innovation, smaller industrial footprint, and global integration.

questions.solution: Large scale manufacturing is characterized by a specialized division of labor, where workers perform repetitive tasks, and the use of mass production techniques. These industries require high capital investment, complex organizational structures, and significant power and technological inputs. They typically produce standardized goods for large markets. In contrast, High Tech industries, or the latest generation of manufacturing, are defined by an intensive focus on research and development. They employ a highly skilled, specialized workforce and are characterized by rapid innovation, shorter product lifecycles, and a smaller, more sophisticated industrial footprint, often concentrated in 'techno-parks' or science corridors, rather than traditional industrial areas.

questions.text:
(a) विश्व अर्थव्यवस्था के विकास में सेवा क्षेत्रक की वृद्धि एवं महत्त्व का मूल्यांकन कीजिए।

questions.text_english:
(a) Assess the growth and significance of service sector in the development of the world economy.
OR
(b) Assess the growth and significance of transport and communication services in the world economy.

key_points: Service sector growth: Shifts from primary/secondary to tertiary/quaternary sectors, increased employment and economic value.
Transport/Communication: Connects markets, reduces costs, enables globalization, information exchange.

questions.solution: The service sector has become the dominant driver of growth in the modern world economy, marking a significant structural shift as nations move from agriculture and manufacturing-based economies to tertiary and quaternary-based ones. This sector encompasses diverse activities ranging from retail, tourism, and logistics to professional services like banking, consulting, and education, creating significant employment and generating high economic value. Complementing this, transport and communication services have acted as the backbone of global development. Advanced transportation allows for the efficient movement of goods and people, while digital communication networks have bridged geographical distances, enabling near-instantaneous global business interaction and knowledge transfer, thereby becoming essential for economic integration.

questions.text_english:
(a) Analyse the rural-urban characteristics of Indian population.
OR
(b) Analyse the main features of the composition of working population in India.

key_points: Rural/Urban: Demographic concentration, migration patterns, infrastructure differences.
Working population: High dependence on primary sector (agriculture), gender disparities in workforce participation, informal sector dominance.

questions.solution: The rural-urban composition of India reflects a population still predominantly living in rural areas, though urban centers are growing rapidly due to migration in search of better economic opportunities. Rural areas are largely dependent on agriculture, with varying levels of infrastructure, while urban areas show higher density and service-based economies. Regarding the working population, India is characterized by a significant dependence on the primary sector, especially agriculture. Although there is a slow shift towards manufacturing and services, the workforce participation rate, particularly for women, remains relatively low compared to international standards. Furthermore, the vast majority of the Indian workforce operates within the informal sector, posing challenges regarding job security and social benefits.

questions.text: (a) "पेट्रोलियम ऊर्जा का एक आवश्यक स्रोत है और इसके शोधन से कई उप-उत्पाद जुड़े हुए हैं।" उदाहरणों सहित इस कथन की व्याख्या कीजिए।
questions.text_english: (a) "Petroleum is an essential source of energy and many byproducts are associated with its refining." Explain this statement with examples.

key_points: Petroleum: Energy source, raw material for chemicals, fertilizers, plastics (examples).
Non-conventional: Solar, wind, geothermal for sustainability, lower carbon footprint.

questions.solution: Petroleum is often called 'liquid gold' because it is not just an essential fuel for transport and power generation but also the feedstock for the petrochemical industry. Its refining processes yield numerous byproducts that are crucial to modern life, including feedstock for fertilizers, synthetic rubber, plastics, textiles, and chemicals. Alternatively, the shift toward non-conventional energy sources like solar, wind, and geothermal power is imperative for sustainable development. Unlike fossil fuels, these sources are inexhaustible and produce significantly fewer greenhouse gas emissions, directly addressing global challenges like climate change and energy security while ensuring long-term ecological balance.
